name: 北森员工档案
description_zh: 查询员工完整档案信息。涵盖基本信息、任职记录、教育背景、专业技能、项目经历、工作履历、考核结果、证书执照、表彰奖励和晋升记录。一站式掌握员工成长轨迹。
description_en: Query complete employee profiles. Covers basic info, employment history, education, professional skills, project experience, work history, performance reviews, certifications, awards, and promotion records.
